```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
risk <- eligible_risk_set(collect(tbl(con, "outcomes")))
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
cast <- running_cast()
bin_breaks <- c(-1, 0, 4, 8, 12, 17)
bin_names <- c("None", "1 to 4", "5 to 8", "9 to 12", "13 to 17")
ex_games <- risk |>
  filter(playerId %in% cast, outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  transmute(
    short = sub(".* ", "", names(cast)[match(playerId, cast)]),
    games = outcome_rookie_games_entry_year,
    bin = cut(games, bin_breaks, labels = bin_names)
  )
bin_labels <- vapply(
  bin_names,
  \(b) {
    who <- ex_games$short[ex_games$bin == b]
    if (length(who)) sprintf("%s (%s)", b, paste(who, collapse = ", ")) else b
  },
  character(1)
)
entrants <- risk |>
  filter(outcome_nfl_entry_d) |>
  mutate(
    games = outcome_rookie_games_entry_year,
    bin = cut(games, breaks = bin_breaks, labels = bin_labels)
  )
games_tab <- entrants |>
  count(bin, name = "n") |>
  mutate(
    share = n / sum(n),
    none = bin == bin_labels[1],
    bin = factor(bin, levels = rev(levels(bin)))
  )

p <- ggplot(games_tab, aes(x = 100 * share, y = bin)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      fill = none,
      tooltip = sprintf("%s games: %s entrants (%.1f%%)", bin, fmt(n), 100 * share),
      data_id = bin
    ),
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * share)), hjust = -0.1, size = 5.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#1B9E77", `FALSE` = "grey65"), guide = "none") +
  expand_limits(x = 100 * max(games_tab$share) + 12) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) sprintf("%.0f%%", x)) +
  labs(
    title = "Rookie-season games played by NFL entrants",
    subtitle = "Share of entrants by regular-season games in their entry year; running examples in parentheses",
    x = "Share of NFL entrants",
    y = "Rookie games played",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "rookie-games", release = release)
card_interactive(p)
```

```{r}
#| label: by-route
games_route <- entrants |>
  mutate(route = if_else(outcome_drafted_d, "Drafted", "Undrafted free agent")) |>
  count(route, games, name = "n") |>
  group_by(route) |>
  mutate(share = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()
p_route <- ggplot(games_route, aes(games, 100 * share, fill = route)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = sprintf(
        "%s, %d rookie games: %s entrants (%.1f%% of the route)",
        route,
        games,
        fmt(n),
        100 * share
      ),
      data_id = paste(route, games)
    ),
    position = position_dodge(preserve = "single"),
    width = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Drafted = "#1B9E77", `Undrafted free agent` = "#7570B3")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 17, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Rookie games played, by entry route",
    subtitle = "Share of each route's entrants by regular-season games in the entry year",
    x = "Rookie games played",
    y = "Share of the route's entrants (%)",
    fill = NULL,
    caption = "Hover a bar for the count."
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_route)
```
